instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: couch co-op was better than online.

Mario Kart 64 split-screen meant hearing your friend scream when your shell hit them. No headset needed. Halo split-screen nights built real friendships. Online lobbies mostly build mute lists. Four friends, one TV, Smash Bros. Melee. Online is convenient, but couch co-op was memorable. Agree?
